name: Martial Eagle
rangeDescription: Savanna and thornbush of sub-saharan africa
description: A massive eagle with a short but prominent crest. The adult is uniformly brown on the head, back, and chest, with a pale belly covered in brown blotches.

name: Dusky-tailed Flatbill
rangeDescription: Far southeastern colombia to northern bolivia and southwestern brazil (mato grosso)
description: Medium-sized, olive-brown flycatcher. Faint reddish wingbars and yellowish undersides, with diffuse olive streaking on the breast.

name: New Caledonian Goshawk
rangeDescription: New caledonia
description: Medium-sized distinctive raptor. Unmistakable adult has a slate-gray hood and upperparts strongly contrasting with a white belly, yellow legs, and bright red eye.

name: Cory's Shearwater
rangeDescription: Eastern atlantic, breeding from azores southward to canary islands and eastward to galicia (northwestern spain) and berlengas islands (off west-central portugal); outside breeding season ranges widely in atlantic, but mainly in upwelling systems of the benguela and agulhas currents
description: Large, lumbering shearwater. Diagnostic yellow bill is often visible from quite a long distance.

name: Sierra Leone Prinia
rangeDescription: Montane ravines of eastern sierra leone, southern guinea, and southwestern ivory coast
description: A mostly dark gray long-tailed warbler with a striking whitish eye, buff flanks, and pinkish legs. Local and scarce in a handful of hills and mountains in Upper Guinea, where pairs and small groups skulk low down in very wet forest edge, riverine scrub, and thickets in gullies between 600 and 1600 meters of elevation.

name: Sichuan Jay
rangeDescription: Mountains of western china (southeastern qinghai, southwestern gansu, and northern sichuan)
description: Sooty jay with a dark head and a bright yellow bill. Unlike many other jays, tends to be quiet and unobtrusive.

name: Macquarie Shag
rangeDescription: Macquarie island and adjacent bishop and clerk rocks
description: Learn about Imperial Cormorant (Macquarie): explore photos, sounds, and observations collected by birders around the world.

name: Kinglet Manakin
rangeDescription: Coastal southeastern brazil (bahia to rio de janeiro)
description: Chunky little, short-tailed bird of lowland and foothill forest. Male is distinctive with bright red crown and bold white stripes on reddish belly.

name: Scottish Crossbill
rangeDescription: Pine forest of northern scotland
description: Crossed bill tips give crossbills their name. Only found in pine forests of Scotland, where uncommon and local.

name: Black-fronted Ground-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Andes of chile and argentina; winters northward to southern peru (arequipa)
description: Breeds locally in the high Andes of central Chile and adjacent Argentina; migrates north in winter. Favors bleak rocky and stony slopes, adjacent bogs, and lakeshores; often in same areas as other ground-tyrant species.

name: Rusty-flanked Jungle Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Montane forest of northern luzon (northern philippines)
description: A medium-sized bird of montane forest in northern Luzon. Large for a flycatcher.

name: Eastern Bonelli's Warbler
rangeDescription: Balkans, türkiye, and levant; winters to sudan
description: A small, pallid, long-winged leaf warbler. Separable from the closely related Western Bonelli's Warbler by range and vocalizations.

name: Anjouan Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Anjouan island (comoros)
description: Small, compact dark owl with tiny ear tufts that are often invisible. The overall coloration can be blackish-brown or rufous-brown.

name: Armenian Gull
rangeDescription: Lakes of caucasus to eastern türkiye and iran; winters to red sea
description: Among large gulls it is rather small and delicate with a short bill and a “sweet” round-headed profile. Adults have a prominent black band across the bill.

name: Brown-rumped Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Santa marta mountains (northeastern colombia)
description: Small, mouse-like bird found only at higher elevations in Colombia’s Santa Marta Mountains. Adult is gray with a bit of brown on the rump and lower underparts.

name: Black Heron
rangeDescription: Locally in sub-saharan africa and madagascar
description: Chunky, mid-sized, blackish heron. The bill and legs are black and the feet are yellow.

name: Sao Tome White-eye
rangeDescription: São tomé island (gulf of guinea)
description: A small, active, mostly dull olive-green and gray warbler-like bird with a yellowish throat and a white eye-ring that is obvious with a good view. Endemic to São Tomé, where small groups regularly join mixed-species flocks.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Malaysian Honeyguide
rangeDescription: Southern peninsular thailand, adjacent myanmar, malay peninsula, sumatra, and borneo
description: Uncommon and unobtrusive in lowland and foothill forests. Unremarkable yet distinctive in its appearance: olive brown above and pale below with a bicolored bill, somewhat resembling a large-bodied, small-headed sparrow in structure if not in size.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Satin Berrypecker
rangeDescription: Western new guinea (fakfak and kumawa mountains, bird's neck)
description: First observed in 2014 and only formally described in 2021, this small, long-tailed bird has only been found in cloud forests at 900-1500 meters in the Kumawa and Fakfak Mountains of West Papua. Male is glossy dark blue above and gleaming white below (faint yellow wash sometimes visible); compare with male Fan-tailed Berrypecker, which has grayish underparts.

name: Malayan Whistling-Thrush
rangeDescription: Moist montane forest of central malaya
description: Dark bluish thrush-like bird with a bright yellow bill. Found solely in the highlands of peninsular Malaysia.
